basic_profile.bio: I'm a curious soul from Oakland, California, who loves to explore new ideas and discuss thought-provoking topics. My interests include philosophy, urban development, and the intersection of technology and society. I work as a junior urban planner and spend my free time hiking in the East Bay hills or reading sci-fi novels. I'm single and enjoy the independence that comes with it. You can usually find me online in the evenings, after work, catching up on the latest discussions or sharing a new discovery. My dislikes include negativity and closed-mindedness.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a bachelor's degree in Urban Studies and have always been interested in how cities evolve and grow. Most of my knowledge comes from academic studies and hands-on experience working on community planning projects. I also enjoy self-teaching through documentaries and podcasts about urban issues.
